viewpoints.name: 1. Entering Lower Wych (Bridge & Dutch Barn)
viewpoints.description: From Lower Wych Bridge looking SE along The Wychough past the dark curved-roof Dutch barn on the right and Wych Brook Cottage on the left towards red-brick The Haven at the junction.

viewpoints.name: 2. Lower Wych Road Looking North (Wrexham Border)
viewpoints.description: Looking north up Lower Wych Road towards the junction with The Wychough, with the roadside red-brick barn on the left and 2-storey red-brick The Haven on the right.

viewpoints.name: 3. SY14 7JX: Valley Chapel, Vale Cottage & Brook Side
viewpoints.description: On Wigland Hall Lane looking WSW around the bend past red-brick Brook Side and pale-green rendered Vale Cottage on the right towards red-brick Valley Chapel (SY14 7JX) on the left.
viewpoints.referenceSource: Geograph #4421157 "The Bishop Bennet Way at Lower Wych" (Jeff Buck)

viewpoints.name: 4. Entrance to Hill Farm & Beech View
viewpoints.description: Looking east down the Hill Farm driveway off The Wychough between the high red-brick farmyard wall on the left and Beech View + mature oak tree + double garage on the right.

viewpoints.name: 5. Lower Wych Bridge (Grade II Listed)
viewpoints.description: Looking NW across the Grade II listed sandstone ashlar parapets of Lower Wych Bridge over Wych Brook (England–Wales border).
